title: Split acre into a library, a CLI and a GUI crate
body:
`acre` was one package. The `acre` library and the `acre` binary shared one `Cargo.toml`. A program that depended on the library compiled `clap` and `anyhow`, and would have compiled the GUI toolkit too.

## Proposal

Jack chose a virtual workspace under `crates/`, with one version and one changelog per crate.

| crate | binary | holds |
|---|---|---|
| `acre` | none | `lang`, `scene`, `render`, the embedded font |
| `acre-cli` | `acre` | `check` and `render` |
| `acre-gui` | `acre-gui` | the editor, in its own issue |
close_reason: Library and CLI split landed in 735a43c. `acre-gui` gets its own crate in the GUI v0 issue.
